summary.tldr: Creates a federal disability benefit to reduce poverty and support the financial security of working-age people with disabilities.
what_it_does: Creates the Canada disability benefit for working-age persons with disabilities.
Sets out the basic rules for how the benefit will be administered.
Lets the Governor in Council fill in most design details through regulations.
Makes a related amendment to the Income Tax Act.
who_it_affects: People who apply for the benefit
summary.background: The bill was introduced in the House of Commons on June 2, 2022, and given first reading.
